title: Prisma with Server Actions
description: Call Prisma from Next.js Server Actions to perform database mutations from client components.

data.text: Server Actions run on the server and can safely access Prisma Client. They provide a clean way to perform database mutations from client components without building separate API routes.

data.title: Server Action with Prisma
data.content: Create a Server Action that creates a post.

data.title: Client Component Calling Server Action
data.content: Call the Server Action from a client component.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use `revalidatePath` or `revalidateTag` after mutations to update the cache and ensure users see fresh data.
